name: georgia_product_liability
description: Historical agentic output — long common path; passes Track A with HIGH_PATH_RATIO warning only

data.text: Are you dealing with a product-related injury or damage?
data.help_text: Select Yes if your issue involves a physical product causing injury or damage.

data.text: Is the entity you are considering taking action against the manufacturer or designer of the product?
data.help_text: Check the product label or documentation to identify the original manufacturer.

data.text: Does the product have a design, manufacturing, or warning defect?
data.help_text: A defect could be a flaw in design, incorrect manufacturing, or inadequate instructions/warnings.

data.text: Was the defect present when the product entered the stream of commerce?
data.help_text: Determine whether the defect was inherent to the product before reaching the consumer.

data.text: How long ago did the injury or damage occur?
data.help_text: Use records or receipts to determine the date of the incident.

data.text: Was the product used in its intended manner or a way that was reasonably foreseeable to the manufacturer?
data.help_text: Consider if the product was being used as expected or in a way that's predictable.

data.text: To what extent do you believe you are at fault for the incident?
data.help_text: Consider all contributing factors and your role in the incident.

data.title: Pursue Strict Product Liability Against Manufacturer
data.summary: You have a case for strict product liability as the manufacturer is involved, a defect was present, and you are within the statutory limits using the product as intended with less than 50% fault.

data.title: Consider Negligence or Warranty Claim Against Downstream Seller
data.summary: The entity is not the manufacturer, but consider negligence or warranty claims.

data.title: No Product Liability
data.summary: Based on your responses, strict product liability cannot be pursued in your situation.

metadata.title: Determining Strict Product Liability in Georgia
metadata.description: A guide to assess if strict product liability applies in Georgia based on your responses.
